target_stage: Original eviction adjudication by the Additional Rent Controller.
target_court: Additional Rent Controller-02, Central District, Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi

IK-191402169:L75:span1.text: The respondent has sub-let, assigned or otherwise parted with the possession of the premises under the tenancy of the respondent to a Wine merchant and wine and bear shop is being run in the premises in dispute.

IK-191402169:L76:span2.text: The said sub-letting, assigning or parting with the possession of the suit premises has been done by the respondents without obtaining the consent in writing of the petitioner after 9th day of June, 1952.

IK-191402169:L87:span3.text: It is denied that the respondent has sub-let, assigned or otherwise parted with the possession of the premises under the tenancy of the respondent to a Wine Merchant or Wine or bear shop is being run in the premises in dispute as alleged.

IK-191402169:L88:span4.text: the wine or bear shop is being run in the tenanted shop since 1985 on license basis given by the respondents without paying of rent with the permission of deceased landlord Sheikh Mohd. Yusuf

IK-191402169:L91:span6.text: The legal possession of the shop is with the respondent and DTTDC is only a licensee and is being permitted to use the shop for selling the wine
